summary.name: OmniMac
summary.one_liner: A free, open source macOS menu bar app that bundles eleven utilities (notch panel, keep-awake, window snapping, clipboard history, screenshots, audio control, app uninstaller, system monitor and more) into one lightweight app.
use_cases: keep a Mac awake with the lid closed
switch windows with thumbnails instead of apps
snap and resize windows with keyboard shortcuts
keep clipboard history of text, images and files
capture a scrolling web page or OCR text from the screen
set per-app volume and a 10-band equaliser
completely uninstall a Mac app and its leftovers
monitor CPU, memory, temperature and battery health
summary.what_it_does: OmniMac is a single menu bar app with eleven modules that can each be switched on or off. Modules cover a notch panel (music, file tray with AirDrop, calendar, timer), keep-awake with closed-lid and battery triggers, Alt-Tab style window switching with thumbnails, window snapping and saved layouts, a clipboard history, screenshots with scrolling capture and OCR, per-app volume and equaliser, hiding menu bar icons, an app uninstaller that also finds leftovers, and a system monitor with battery health. The page reports 0.017–0.033 % CPU at idle and about 16 MB on disk, and says it sends no telemetry.
notable: Eleven modules in one resident app, each toggled independently, with the page claiming lower memory use than eight separate apps (86 MB vs 851 MB for the menu bar apps it compares against)
Works on MacBooks without a notch by drawing a floating island instead
Uninstaller moves everything to the Trash and finds leftovers of already-deleted apps
MIT licensed; the page says the code is public and can be built from source
caveats: Not signed with an Apple developer account, so macOS shows a warning on first launch and requires opening it via System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway
Some features need permissions such as Accessibility, Screen Recording, and Calendar, and the page's performance figures come from the author's own single-machine measurements
